title: Marketing Manager
description:
Marketing Manager - Brand & CRM North West Online Retailer Salary £45k - £55k + Benefits

An exciting opportunity has arisen for a commercially minded Marketing Manager to join an established, growing ecommerce business.

This is a hands-on, varied role combining brand development, CRM, product marketing and multi-channel campaign delivery. The successful candidate will take ownership of customer engagement, retention and brand consistency, creating compelling campaigns that drive measurable commercial results.

The Marketing Manager will work closely with senior leadership, balancing creative thinking with a data-led approach to marketing.

Key Responsibilities
- Develop and deliver engaging product marketing campaigns across digital channels.
- Own CRM and email marketing, including segmentation, automation and customer lifecycle journeys.
- Drive customer retention, repeat purchase and lifetime value.
- Maintain consistent brand positioning, messaging and creative standards.
- Manage campaign content, creative briefs and external partners.
- Analyse campaign performance, customer behaviour and commercial KPIs.
- Identify opportunities to improve engagement, conversion and revenue.
- Manage marketing budgets and maximise return on investment.

About You
- Proven experience as a Marketing Manager or Senior Marketing Executive within ecommerce, retail or a consumer brand.
- Strong hands-on CRM and email marketing experience.
- Experience developing and delivering multi-channel marketing campaigns.
- A strong understanding of brand marketing, customer engagement and product storytelling.
- Commercially driven, with the ability to translate data into actionable insights.
- Confident managing creative content, external partners and multiple priorities.
- A proactive, organised individual who enjoys both strategy and hands-on delivery.

This Marketing Manager opportunity offers genuine ownership, variety and the chance to make a measurable impact within a growing business.

Apply today to find out more.

title: Marketing Manager
description:
Marketing Manager - Fashion

Cheshire - Hybrid Working

Enhanced Holidays - Birthday Off

40% employee discount.

Private Healthcare & Life Assurance

Are you a creative, commercially minded marketer with a passion for fashion, culture, customers and bringing brilliant ideas to life? Do you love spotting opportunities, creating campaigns that get people talking and turning great ideas into tangible results? If so, this could be the role for you.

We're looking for an ambitious and hands-on Marketing Manager to help grow an established and exciting womenswear business across every customer touchpoint. This is an opportunity for someone who combines creative thinking with commercial instinct, understands what makes customers engage and knows how to turn inspiration into impactful marketing activity.

Key Responsibilities
- Develop and deliver creative, integrated marketing campaigns across digital, social, retail and third-party channels.
- Bring a strong understanding of fashion, culture, trends and the zeitgeist to ensure marketing feels current, relevant and engaging.
- Translate product stories, customer insights and commercial priorities into exciting campaign concepts and content ideas.
- Identify opportunities to connect the business with relevant cultural moments, trends, conversations and audiences.
- Support seasonal campaigns, product launches, key trading periods, events and marketing activations.
- Work closely with the Creative team to develop briefs and bring marketing concepts to life through compelling content and execution.
- Plan, coordinate and manage marketing, advertising and promotional activity across channels, including digital marketing, social media, CRM, email, direct mail and TV.
- Develop and support customer acquisition and retention marketing strategies, helping to attract new customers and strengthen loyalty among existing ones.
- Ensure marketing activity is aligned with wider business objectives, with clear plans, responsibilities and timelines across relevant teams.
- Manage campaigns from initial idea through to delivery, ensuring projects are delivered on time, within budget and to a high standard.
- Use customer data, market insight and campaign performance to understand what resonates, measure effectiveness and inform future activity.
- Monitor competitor activity, emerging trends and the wider fashion and retail landscape to identify opportunities.

What We're Looking For
- Proven experience in a marketing, brand, fashion, retail, lifestyle or consumer-facing role.
- A strong creative instinct and the ability to develop original ideas and turn them into actionable marketing campaigns.
- A genuine passion for fashion, culture, social media and the ever-changing consumer landscape.
- A natural curiosity about trends, cultural moments and conversations, with the ability to identify relevant opportunities.
- A strong understanding of social media, content creation, brand storytelling and integrated marketing.
- Commercial awareness and an understanding of how effective marketing drives customer engagement, acquisition, retention and revenue growth.
- Experience managing multiple marketing projects and campaigns, from briefing through to execution.
- Excellent communication, organisation and project management skills, with the confidence to influence and collaborate with stakeholders across the business.
- Comfortable working at pace, managing competing priorities and bringing people together to make things happen.
- Confident using data, customer insight and performance metrics to inform decisions, while maintaining a strong creative perspective.
- A proactive, energetic and collaborative approach, with the confidence to challenge the obvious and bring new thinking to the table.

title: Part Time Marketing Executive
description:
Part-Time Marketing Executive

Chester - Office Based - 20 hours per week

Salary: 30,000 Pro Rata

The Opportunity:

Get Recruited are recruiting on behalf of a well established business based in Chester who are looking for a proactive, self sufficient Part Time Marketing Executive to join the team. This is a varied, standalone role suited to someone who is confident working independently, enjoys getting stuck in and can bring fresh ideas to the business.

This is a great opportunity for someone from a Marketing Assistant, Marketing Executive, Digital Marketing Assistant, Digital Marketing Executive, Social Media Executive or similar type or role.

The Role:
- Manage and update the company website, ensuring content is engaging and up to date.
- Create and schedule organic social media content.
- Plan and deliver email marketing campaigns.
- Support the selection and implementation of a CRM system.
- Produce marketing materials, graphics and digital content using tools such as Canva.
- Maintain customer databases and mailing lists.
- Monitor marketing activity and identify opportunities for improvement.
- Take ownership of day-to-day marketing activities and help develop the company's online presence.

The Person:
- Experience with website updates, social media and email marketing.
- Confident using tools such as Canva and Mailchimp or similar.
- Strong communication, organisation and content creation skills.
- Proactive, self-sufficient and comfortable working in a standalone role.
- CRM and SEO experience would be advantageous but isn't essential.
- This is a great opportunity for a Marketing Assistant looking to step up or an experienced Marketing Executive seeking a flexible, part-time role with plenty of autonomy.
- The role is 20 hours per week, with flexibility around how these hours are spread across the working week.

title: Senior Digital Marketing Executive
description:
If you love generating leads and thrive on seeing your marketing directly contribute to sales growth - This is your chance to take the lead.

We're looking for a Senior Digital Marketing Executive to own the marketing function within a growing family business that is a leading supplier of technical chemical solutions. It is a varied role spanning strategy, content, digital marketing, events, and automation

Reporting directly to the CEO, you'll be given the autonomy to shape marketing strategy, build powerful lead generation campaigns, and position the business as the go-to expert within its markets.

From LinkedIn campaigns and technical content to video production, CRM automation, SEO, events, and website optimisation, you'll combine strategic thinking with hands-on delivery to create marketing that drives real commercial results.

With ambitious growth plans across the UK and Europe, we're looking for someone who can consistently attract qualified prospects, convert interest into opportunities, and help fuel the next stage of the company's success.

If you're commercially minded, creative, and passionate about generating leads that convert into customers, we'd love to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities
- Develop and deliver the annual digital marketing strategy.
- Drive qualified lead generation through multiple digital channels.
- Create engaging content including blogs, whitepapers, videos, case studies, and technical resources.
- Manage and grow the company's LinkedIn presence through thought leadership campaigns.
- Plan and execute email marketing campaigns and lead nurturing activities.
- Oversee website performance, SEO optimisation, and content updates.
- Support European market expansion through targeted digital campaigns.

Requirements
- Proven Experience in Digital Marketing
- Proven track record of generating qualified leads through digital channels.
- Experience creating and executing email marketing campaigns.
- Strong website management experience, ideally including Shopify.
- Experience using CRM and marketing automation platforms
- Strong content creation skills, including technical writing.
- Videography, photography, and video editing experience.

Highly Desirable:
- Marketing, Chemistry, or Science-related degree.
- Experience creating technical content or working within technical, manufacturing, engineering, chemical, or industrial sectors.
- Strong Understanding of AI and Marketing automation tools

Benefits
- Starting salary £35,000 - £40,000
- Huge opportunity to own, develop and grow the marketing function.
- High level of autonomy and responsibility.

Please note this is role is 100% office based and it is 40 hour working week but there is flexibility on start and finish times

Hybrid working may be an option further down the line but it is not envisaged will be practical initially.
